results.claim: obra/superpowers is one of the largest projects in the Claude Code ecosystem: 280,000+ GitHub stars and 25,000+ forks (as of September 2026).
results.evidence: Re-fetched the live repo (2026-09-23): ~290,300 stars, ~26,000 forks — both above the stated thresholds (280,000+/25,000+). Per the project's rubric (threshold claims PASS as long as the live value still meets or exceeds the floor), natural growth is not grounds for WARNING.

results.claim: Superpowers는 하나의 Skill이 아니라, 브레인스토밍부터 TDD, 코드 리뷰, 브랜치 정리까지 개발 단계별로 자동 발동하는 Skill 라이브러리 전체를 설치하는 방식의 개발 방법론이다.
results.evidence: README describes itself as 'a complete software development methodology... built on top of a set of composable skills' with documented auto-triggering at each stage: brainstorming (before code), TDD (RED-GREEN-REFACTOR), code review (between tasks), branch cleanup (on completion).

results.claim: Anthropic의 공식 플러그인 마켓플레이스(claude-plugins-official)에 등재되어 있다.
results.evidence: README documents `/plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official` under an 'Official Marketplace' section, distinguished from the separate community marketplace. Independently confirmed claude-plugins-official = anthropics/claude-plugins-official, Anthropic's official-managed plugin directory.

results.claim: Claude Code 외에 Antigravity, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Grok, Kimi Code, OpenCode 등에도 각각의 설치 경로를 지원한다.
results.evidence: README has individual install instructions for all eight named tools. README also lists further tools (Devin CLI, Factory Droid, Pi, Qwen Code, Hermes, Muse) not named in the claim, but the claim's '등' (etc.) already signals a non-exhaustive list.

results.claim: 제작자는 Jesse Vincent이며 Prime Radiant 소속이다.
results.evidence: README's Community section: 'Superpowers is built by Jesse Vincent and the rest of the folks at Prime Radiant.'

results.claim: "superpowers"라는 이름을 쓰는 저장소가 여러 개 있다 — thecodingrobot/superpowers는 obra/superpowers-skills를 런타임에 클론하는 별개의 shim 구조이고, abudhahir/superpowers는 VS Code/GitHub Copilot용의 완전히 무관한 도구이며, jsholmes/superpowers는 obra의 포크(스타 0개)다.
results.evidence: All three sub-claims re-verified: thecodingrobot/superpowers is a shim cloning superpowers-skills to ~/.config/superpowers/skills/; abudhahir/superpowers is a separate VS Code/GitHub Copilot workflow engine; jsholmes/superpowers is 'forked from obra/superpowers' with 0 stars, unchanged. No drift found.

results.claim: 프로젝트는 새 Skill 기여를 받지 않으며 기존 Skill의 수정만 받는다.
results.evidence: README: 'we don't generally accept contributions of new skills and that any updates to skills must work across all of the coding agents we support.'

results.claim: brainstorming skill의 선택적 visual companion 기능이 로고 이미지를 Prime Radiant 서버에서 불러오며 Superpowers 버전 정보만 전송한다 (프로젝트·프롬프트·코딩 에이전트 정보는 포함되지 않음). 기본값은 켜져 있고 SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY 환경변수로 끌 수 있다.
results.evidence: README: the Prime Radiant logo on brainstorming's optional visual companion loads from their site and 'includes the version of Superpowers in use' but 'does not include any details about your project, prompt, or coding agent.' On by default; SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY disables it. Scope, data sent, default-on state, and env var all match exactly — reconfirmed after the claim was narrowed from an earlier overbroad 'general usage telemetry' phrasing.
